strategy_name: Time Series Reversal via End-of-Month Payment Cycle
entry_signal: Buy S&P 500 at the start of the next month if the return of the last week of the current month is negative
exit_signal: Exit (sell) the S&P 500 position at the end of the holding month (i.e., hold for one full calendar month then close)
hidden_params: exact definition of last week of month (calendar days vs trading days)
threshold on volume above which negative serial correlation is stronger (TAR threshold)
expansion vs recession regime filter (NBER real-time vs ex-post)
whether to go short or stay in cash when signal is positive

suggested_defaults.last_week_definition: last 5 trading days of the calendar month
suggested_defaults.volume_tar_threshold: 75th percentile of trailing 12-month average daily volume
suggested_defaults.regime_filter: none (no NBER filter applied in real-time)
